name: Marketing campaign
blurb: One ask runs a whole campaign: research, angles, hooks, posts, ads and a test plan, each step using the Skill Garden guide made for it.
description: Run a full marketing campaign end to end from one request: audience and competitor research, creative strategy and angles, hooks, organic social posts, paid ad copy and a testing plan, using the Skill Garden social-media, content-creation and ad-creation super skills in order. Use when asked to run, plan or build a campaign, a launch push, or 'posts plus ads' for a product, offer or event.
ask: Run a campaign for <product or offer>, aimed at <audience>, on <platforms>.
inputs: What is being promoted and the one action you want
Platforms and whether there is ad budget
Facts you can use: numbers, proof, prices, dates
Brand voice or a sample of past posts

steps.title: Research the audience and competitors
steps.output: What the audience says in their own words, the angles competitors already run, and the gaps.

steps.title: Pick the angles and write the brief
steps.output: A one-page brief: the offer, three to five angles ranked, proof for each, and the one you'd lead with.

steps.title: Write the hooks
steps.output: Ten or more hooks across the chosen angles, in the brand voice.

steps.title: Write the organic posts and calendar
steps.output: Posts for each platform and a two-week calendar.

steps.title: Write the paid ads
steps.output: Ad copy variants per angle that fit each platform's limits.

steps.title: Plan the tests
steps.output: What to test first, the budget split, the metric and when to call a winner.
